snippet.title: Parkasaurus: Dinoluxe Edition - Official Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In Parkasaurus build your own dinosaur theme park full of cute dinos and prehistoric hijinks. Console version includes both the Sea Monsters and Prehistoric Wonders DLCs.
